Stated Claim / Post Context:

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Man convicted of arson over deadly 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles ===

[Source 1 — www.dw.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.dw.com/en/man-convicted-of-arson-over-deadly-2025-palisades-fire-in-los-angeles/a-80007933?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-xml-mrss):
Man convicted of arson over deadly 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles

A 30-year-old man has been convicted of causing one of the most destructive wildfires in the history of Los Angeles. The verdict came after the case was retried.

[Source 2 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/man-convicted-of-starting-palisades-fire):
Man convicted of starting palisades fire

A Los Angeles County jury found former rideshare driver Jonathan Rinderknecht guilty on Friday of starting the 2025 Palisades fire, which caused widespread destruction and loss of life. He faces a prison sentence of between five and 40 years. Liza Kaminov has more.

[Source 3 — www.npr.org (Bias: Lean Left / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.npr.org/2026/11/21/nx-s1-6049625/palisades-fire-conviction):
Federal jury convicts man of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles

Prosecutors argued the defendant, 30-year-old Jonathan Rinderknecht, had been "mad at everything" in the days leading up to the January 2025 fire, which killed 12 people.
